Integrated Child
Development
Services (ICDS)
(Saksham
Anganwadi Poshan
2.0) (Centrally
Sponsored Scheme)
column7:
Reduction in provision of
₹8,819.14 lakh was the net
effect of increase of
₹15,155.93 lakh and
surrender of
₹23,975.07 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need of
additional amounts in
wages/ honorarium, dress/
uniform and rent paid and
tax. Surrender of
₹23,975.07 lakh was
attributed to decrease in
the number of
beneficiaries. Final excess
of ₹1,086.09 lakh is
overstated by ₹1,088.94
lakh due to clearance of
OB suspense related to
previous years. Therefore,
it is actual saving of ₹2.85
lakh. Reasons for actual
saving have not been
intimated (July 2024).

sanction from
Contingency Fund for
Mission Vatsalya
Scheme. Final excess of

Reasons for actual saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
